facts.finding: Production factory derives opaque dev cases/runtime labels, original measurable manifest, full backlog and catalog/spec/skill originals; creates real MiningAgentRoleModel and LabelAwareMiningController; local save_need_unit writes canonical unit under axis/seed/result identity.

Actual frozen factory-input preserves full ordered265backlog, six complete Slow originals plus briefs, meta originals/disclosures, footprints, axis and label map, but only case_count for constructor cases and no evidence manifest/catalog/originals/aliases/attribute vocabulary/memory_index.

Constructor derives available families from actual store, validates label/case refs and enriches Signal cards; native view reads the real ReflectionMemoryIndex on every call even if no memory action is selected. factory-input is not a stand-alone lossless constructor snapshot.

_mining_context performs optional H1 source-role reads and builds a scoped index/Slow view. Calling it again without a declared reuse seam could repeat paid selection; replacing it by a mock would bypass the production boundary being claimed.

minimal_reviewable_option.scope: A new assigned-target Controller-only diagnostic at the sealed preanswer frontier, reusing previously produced and independently reviewed input; no source/Reflect rerun and no v1 resume.
minimal_reviewable_option.production_change: Extract a small shared private constructor/factory and original need-unit persistence helper from the existing factory. The normal factory and diagnostic must both invoke that real helper; preserve existing constructor validation and sink behavior. A method that merely returns hand-built model JSON is insufficient.
minimal_reviewable_option.context_seam: Supply the sealed actual produced context as explicit module-stage inputs with origin/artifact hashes. Reconstruct required existing index/case/catalog/store inputs through their native read-only constructors and ensure first native view equals the source Controller view except declared assignment/envelope/new independent budget identity. Do not mock the factory, _memory_view or evidence/source validators.
minimal_reviewable_option.inputs: Preserve full265backlog order/hash and original target action sourcehash; six complete originals and their actual role scopes/closure; meta disclosures/index; exact dev opaque mapping/time/labels and no check label leakage; measurable manifest; stable Signal originals and prior footprints; real qualified store and identity guards.
minimal_reviewable_option.assignment: Declare only which original need_ref is the task and that other needs remain pending; do not supply required disposition or repair diagnosis. Retain the native full backlog/controlled page and native base-hash calculation, not a singleton backlog.
minimal_reviewable_option.progress: Bind the source preanswer frontier explicitly. v1 remains terminal with its unrelated saved intent and target0/1. New unit belongs to the new module diagnostic and is not a replacement or second independent credit for the old intent; no active/current business pointer or old pending set is rewritten.
minimal_reviewable_option.contract: New stage execution budget/permissions are frozen explicitly and counted only for its actual fresh Controller requests. Keep source memory/input contract_hashes unchanged and bind them as provenance; never retag old memory with the new contract, promote it to committed Slow history, or inherit source execution permission/budget.
minimal_reviewable_option.sink: Shared original persistence helper writes only the new owned module workspace and exits at first native accepted need unit whether semantic pass/fail. No discovery seed, candidate work, Signal, Fast/Slow pointer completion, publication, or history installation.

blocking_conditions_before_execution: Factory-input alone cannot satisfy all native constructor/index dependencies. A concrete implementation must show exact reconstruction or a verified materialization of those missing inputs; no silent defaults/facades.

The new entry must explicitly distinguish diagnostic input reuse from committed-history admission. Current v1 completed pointers remain0/0, so its memory cannot be fed to the existing committed-import API as a successful cycle.
Source prior unit must not be copied into a fresh staged-state set and then compared to the preanswer basehash; choose and freeze one explicit frontier, retain original result separately.
authority_assessment: This internal bounded diagnostic task-selection seam does not by itself alter research definition, canonical SignalResult, scoring/PIT/LockedTest or grant business history admission; no automatic need for a new user design decision. Its actual run/budget still needs the existing root authorization/freeze. Any widening to persistent cross-run reuse/history admission would be a separate contract decision.
acceptance_counterexamples: Same265rows with changed order, a different target source hash, or singleton backlog must reject before request/write.
A complete module but business pointers0/0 must be accepted only as declared look-stage input, not committed history.
All six Slow originals must retain original content/provenance and H1 visibility; hidden/source omitted material cannot be broadened by mere file presence.
Newassigned stage may not replay old83/84 answers as fresh model behavior or use the old role context.
Mocked index/empty store that yields a superficially similar JSON request must not pass the native construction claim.
limits: Read-only static design review only; no native constructor, Store, stage command, model, GET, Signal or LabelStore invoked. No mixed approved case envelope deserialized.
No new interface/code/schema or policy is implemented by this document. The shared helper and lossless input seam require candidate implementation review.
The previous stage target0/1 and other intent semantics remain unchanged; no full S1/S2/MVP or benefit claim.
